entities.summary: Joe Steve Vásquez is an American Catholic prelate who serves as Archbishop of Galveston–Houston since 2025. He previously served as Bishop of Austin from 2010 to 2025 and as apostolic administrator of the Diocese of Tyler from 2023 to 2024. He was an auxiliary bishop of Galveston-Houston from 2001 to 2010.
